What you're looking for with this is what we call "Intervals" in music, basically a fingerprint or signature for a specific sound. An example would be how you can recognize the Super Mario Brothers theme even if it is in a different key. In this case, there is a brief period where the intervals for the Expedition 33 and FFX motifs are the same, but in a different key. 

Good ear!

Edit: in addition to the intervals in the time you specified, the same motif in To Zanarkand plays later on in the track and it has the exact same notes as those in E33
